slides.title:
Mistakes we make when we
try to come back to Allah.
slides.sub: I've made every one of these.
slides.closer: Save this for the next time you restart.

slides.title: Waiting to feel ready.

diagram.js: const y0=H*0.5; const a=[]; for(let x=40;x<=W-40;x+=26){a.push([x, y0-60+Math.sin(x/55)*95*Math.sin(x/170)])} P.curve(a,{c:T.muted,w:3.2,dash:[14,11]}); P.text(W-50,y0-195,'how ready you feel',{c:T.muted,size:26,anchor:'end'}); const b=[]; for(let x=40;x<=W-40;x+=40){b.push([x,y0+130-(x-40)/(W-80)*150])} P.curve(b,{c:'#f4c430',w:5}); P.text(60,y0+180,'what showing up builds',{c:'#f4c430',size:26,anchor:'start'}); P.fig('sit',60,H*0.5-140,110,{c:T.muted,a:T.muted}); P.fig('walk',W-90,H*0.5-30,120,{c:'#f4c430',a:'#f4c430'});

slides.body: Feelings follow actions. Pray first. The feeling usually shows up after, not before. **Don't wait for the mood.**

slides.title: Changing everything at once.

diagram.js: const y=H*0.86; P.line(20,y,W-20,y,{c:'#f7f4ee',w:2.4}); const lx=W*0.27; for(let i=0;i<5;i++){P.rect(lx-55+(P.R()-0.5)*16,y-170-(i+1)*44,110,40,i==0?{fill:'#f4c430',c:'#f4c430'}:{c:'#f7f4ee'})} P.fig('person',lx,y-85,170,{c:'#f7f4ee'}); P.text(lx,y+40,'everything at once',{c:'#f7f4ee',size:27}); const rx=W*0.73; P.rect(rx-45,y-212,90,40,{fill:'#f4c430',c:'#f4c430'}); P.fig('walk',rx,y-85,170,{c:'#f7f4ee'}); P.text(rx,y+40,'one, every day',{c:'#f4c430',size:27});

slides.body: Ten new habits on Monday, none by Friday. **The most beloved deed to Allah is the most constant, even if it is small.**

slides.title: Giving your phone the first minutes.
slides.body: Whatever gets your first minutes sets the tone of your day. Give them to Fajr and your morning adhkar, not the feed.

slides.title: Comparing yourself to their highlights.
slides.body: You see their best minute and judge your whole day by it. Look at your own deeds, not their feed.

slides.title: Hiding from Allah after a slip.
slides.body: A slip is not the end of your comeback. Staying away is. **Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.**

slides.title: Which ones are you making?

items.text: I'm waiting until I feel ready
I'm trying to change everything at once
My phone gets my first minutes
I compare my deen to their posts
I hide from Allah after I slip

slides.closer: Pick one. Fix it this week.
